title: Align Dev And Build Optimization Profiles
description: Split dev (fast compile, console-only) vs build (release LTO, vite minify/drop). Implement plan dev_build_opt_profiles.
summary: Dev wasm fast path: semioBuildMode drives wasm-pack --dev and cargo dev (no wasm-opt); ship sets SEMIO_BUILD_MODE=ship for wasm-release and binaryen. Plugin artifacts resolve debug then wasm-release in os run and root preflight. Continues prior dev vs release profile split (LTO, Vite, Go, CMake).
